purpose: Assemble only components that already passed their upstream gates into 50,000 legally valid current-law elections; do not tune the forecast from resulting seat probabilities.

vote_generator.national_uncertainty: M26-NATIONAL-UNCERTAINTY-V1: spherical simplex-tangent Student-t df=3, prospective scale=max historical selected-model national residual RMSE, seed 26092352
vote_generator.territorial_center: national_draw + 0.5*(territory_2021-national_2021), normalized then raked to the exact national draw using 2021 local valid-vote weights
vote_generator.geography_residuals: sample complete nine-party raw share residual rows actual-minus-conditional-center from 2007_TO_2011, 2011_TO_2016 and 2016_TO_2021; 241 rows total
vote_generator.post_residual: floor, row-normalize, then rake all 92 territories back to the same exact national draw

regional_ballot_bridge.formula: For each region and draw, regional_share_2026 is proportional to regional_share_2021 * simulated_local_region_share_2026 / local_region_share_2021, componentwise, then normalized.
regional_ballot_bridge.interpretation: Transfer the simulated local partisan swing into the 2021 regional-ballot composition while preserving the region-specific 2021 regional-versus-local ballot propensity.
regional_ballot_bridge.limitation: 2021 is the only election with the current regional-list ballot, so this bridge has no historical current-system transition for calibration.

reused_structural_legal_mechanics.registered_N: reuse frozen latent N92 posterior sampler; every draw sums to 15,801,162
reused_structural_legal_mechanics.turnout: reuse robust F-1 V1.1 turnout hierarchy only; old F-1 vote uncertainty is not reused
reused_structural_legal_mechanics.valid_vote_fraction: reuse frozen 2011 local valid-vote fraction model and 2021 regional-to-local valid-vote bridge
reused_structural_legal_mechanics.eligible_lists: positive-vote 2021 lists only, as in F-1 V1.1
reused_structural_legal_mechanics.OTHER: split to actual positive-vote 2021 minor-party codes in observed proportions
reused_structural_legal_mechanics.integer_votes: one support vote per eligible list plus balanced randomized rounding
reused_structural_legal_mechanics.statutory_tie_prior: UNKNOWN_AGE_EXCHANGEABLE; uniformly sample required lists without replacement only inside a binding equal-remainder group

fail_closed_invariants: Every national vote draw is finite, strictly positive after numerical floor and sums to one.
Every pre-legal 92-territory weighted aggregate matches its same national draw within 1e-8.
Every local and regional share row is finite, non-negative and normalized.
Every N92 draw contains 92 positive integers summing to 15,801,162.
Every contest has at least as many eligible positive-vote lists as seats and every eligible list receives at least one simulated valid vote.
Zero unresolved statutory ties after exchangeable-age marginalization.
All 104 contests allocate their exact configured magnitudes.
Every national draw sums to exactly 395 seats.
promotion_rule: PROMOTED only if all fail-closed invariants pass for all 50,000 draws. Seat probabilities may not be used to revise the already-frozen point or uncertainty parameters.
mandatory_limitations: Only five historical national transitions inform prospective national tails.
Conditional geography residuals are exchangeable across territories and cannot identify territory-specific variance robustly.
The regional-ballot bridge is structural and uncalibrated under the current system because no prior transition exists.
Local registered-voter counts remain latent rather than official 2026 local counts.
2021 list availability is a structural placeholder; verified 2026 list changes require a later immutable snapshot.
Binding remainder ties use an exchangeable prior because candidate ages are not part of this structural snapshot.
